# AI Operations Partners

> AI Operations Partners runs a fully managed, AI-powered lead generation service built only for Fractional CFO practices. Its AI Growth Engine finds business owners who are showing signs they need a CFO, reaches out on the practice's behalf, and uses an AI SDR (sales development representative) to answer replies and book qualified sales calls directly onto the practice's calendar. Outreach is live within 21 days of kickoff, guaranteed. The company was founded by Jacob Krogue, CPA.

## Key facts

- Company: AI Operations Partners (https://aioperationspartners.com)
- What it does: Outbound lead generation and appointment setting for Fractional CFO firms, using AI
- Who it serves: Fractional CFO practices and outsourced CFO firms (US-based)
- Main service: The AI Growth Engine, a fully managed outbound sales system with a 24/7 AI SDR
- Guarantee: Outreach live within 21 days of the kickoff call, or the first month's management fee is free
- Pricing model: One-time setup fee plus a flat monthly management fee; 90-day initial term, then month to month. Clients own their lists, messaging and sending domains.
- Founder: Jacob Krogue, CPA, Founder and CEO
- Contact: info@aioperationspartners.com

## The AI Growth Engine: how it works

1. Define the ideal client: industries, company size, decision makers, and what "qualified" means to the practice (one 60-minute kickoff).
2. Build and approve: prospect lists, dedicated sending domains, messaging in the practice's voice, and AI SDR training. The practice approves all messaging before anything is sent.
3. Outreach and replies: outreach goes out in small, targeted batches. The AI SDR replies within minutes, screens out poor fits, and books qualified prospects.
4. Calls and reporting: qualified calls appear on the practice's calendar with a call brief. Regular reporting follows.

The AI SDR never claims to be a person. If asked, it says it is an AI assistant working with the practice, and it hands sensitive or unusual conversations to a person.

## Buying signals it watches for

Business owners tend to look for a fractional CFO at specific moments, including: hiring a controller with no CFO above them, searching for a finance leader, opening a new location, taking on new debt, raising outside capital (SEC Form D filings), growing fast, making an acquisition, a new CEO or owner, winning a government contract, and a nonprofit growing quickly.

## About the founder

Jacob Krogue is a CPA with a master's degree in accounting from BYU. He was the founding employee at a Fractional CFO firm and helped grow it from 8 to more than 30 clients before it was acquired. He started in public accounting and now leads an accounting and finance team at a SaaS company in Boston, including its AI transformation. He co-hosts the AI Rebels podcast (https://airebelspod.com/) and hosts Rolling Forecast, a podcast for Fractional CFO founders.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jacobkrogue
